sourcePolicy: Read-only source proxy; all funding, mining, donations, trades and simulations occur on owned descendants

rehearsal.summary: Selected backlog processed within the reviewed policy
rehearsal.authorization: Impersonated Safe on disposable child only; not proof of owner signatures or Safe execution gas
assumptions: One second of child chain time per rehearsal transaction
Child funds and relaxed gas/code limits are simulation allowances, not public execution guarantees

feeEstimate.note: Measured child gas multiplied by the source RPC gas price at rehearsal start. Local-fork gas price is not a public-network fee estimate. Excludes Safe signature/execution overhead and any additional chain-specific fees; actual fees may change.
